title: Microsoft Teams: intelligent call recaps for call queue calls in the Queues app
summary: Hold for an incorrect administrator prerequisite and an inconsistent statement about who can see recaps. Microsoft says the template creator becomes its SharePoint site administrator; existing site administrator access is required to assign a template or manage authorized users. The impact rationale asserts a recap audience that the body correctly says is not documented.
